displayConfig.template:
<Stack gap="sm" p="xs">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center">
    <Group gap="xs">
      <Avatar src="https://jellyglance.com/project-logo.png" size={24} radius="xl" />
      <Stack gap={0}>
        <Text fw={800} size="sm">Digest</Text>
        
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <Badge variant="light" color={data.digestOk ? "teal" : "red"}>{data.digestOk ? "Clear" : String(data.digest) + " items"}</Badge>
  </Group>
  <Stack gap="xs">
    {data.items.map((row) =>
      <Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs">
        <Group justify="space-between">
          <Text size="sm">{row.label}</Text>
          <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{row.type}</Text>
        </Group>
      </Card>
    )}
  </Stack>
</Stack>
